integrity: Universal formulas are proved by explicit finite-rank mass-matrix inversion and rational inequalities; exact-arithmetic checks are supplementary. Possible unindexed equivalent literature and incomplete full text for Boman (2006) remain risks.
scientific_limitations: Unit midpoint segmentation, equal-length star arms, constant positive arclength density, real L2 orthogonal projection onto continuous piecewise-linear splines. Not a general mesh-refinement monotonicity statement.
title: Midpoint refinement reverses sharp affine-projection stability at four arms
